title: Product Rule: Visualizing h(x) = x² sin x and Its Derivative
caption_md: The blue curve is $h(x)=x^2\sin x$, and the dashed orange curve is its derivative $h'(x)=2x\sin x + x^2\cos x$, computed via the product rule. The tangent line is drawn at $x=1.5$. Notice that the tangent line's slope equals the value of the orange curve at $x=1.5$. Where the orange curve crosses zero, the blue curve has a local max or min — the tangent line there would be horizontal.
